title: Gusty Descent
pitch: Pilot a fragile lunar lander through random wind gusts on a tight fuel budget and touch down softly on one of three pads, each worth a different score.
coreLoop: Watch the wind indicator, rotate and feather the main thruster to counter gravity and gusts, line up over the pad you're gambling on, and bleed off speed for a gentle, level touchdown before fuel runs dry.
mechanics: Constant lunar gravity pulls the lander down; the main thruster pushes along the lander's facing direction and burns fuel while held
Rotation with left/right keys, clamped to +/-90 degrees from vertical; rotating costs no fuel
Wind: a horizontal force that changes every 3-6 seconds to a random value, with occasional short strong gusts; the next gust is telegraphed 1 second ahead by a flashing arrow on the HUD

Three landing pads on procedurally generated jagged terrain: a wide pad worth 1x, a medium pad worth 2x, and a narrow pad worth 3x, with the high-value pad placed in harder spots (in a valley or on a peak)
Safe landing requires both feet on a pad, vertical speed < 40 px/s, horizontal speed < 25 px/s, and tilt < 12 degrees; anything else, or touching the terrain, is a crash
Landing score = pad multiplier x (100 + remaining fuel bonus); the score carries over between levels
Level progression: after a safe landing the next level begins with new terrain, stronger wind, and slightly less starting fuel; land on 5 levels to win
3 lives; a crash costs a life and restarts the current level with the same terrain
HUD shows fuel bar, vertical/horizontal speed (green when safe, red when unsafe), altitude, the wind arrow and its strength, score, lives, and level

controls.action: Start game / restart after win or loss

winCondition: Land safely on any pad on all 5 levels.
loseCondition: Lose all 3 lives through crashes. Running out of fuel is not an instant loss, but the lander will free-fall and likely crash.

entities.name: Lander
entities.description: A small triangular capsule with two angled legs and a flame cone that flickers while thrusting. It has position, velocity, angle, and fuel.

entities.name: Terrain
entities.description: A jagged grey polyline generated per level from random midpoint displacement, with three flat segments carved out for the pads.

entities.name: Landing Pad
entities.description: A flat segment with colored beacon lights and a floating label (x1/x2/x3). The width shrinks as the multiplier rises.

entities.name: Wind
entities.description: An invisible horizontal force, shown by the HUD arrow and by drifting dust particles streaking across the screen.

entities.name: Particles
entities.description: Thruster exhaust, drifting dust, and a crash explosion burst, all made from small circles.

artDirection: Vector-retro look on a black starfield: a thin-lined white lander, grey terrain outline filled with dark slate, glowing colored pads, and an orange/yellow thruster flame. All art is drawn with Phaser Graphics. The camera is fixed, and the world scales to fit the viewport at a 16:9 logical resolution of 1280x720.
audio: WebAudio only, with the context created lazily on the first key press. Thruster: looping filtered noise whose gain follows the thrust key. Wind gust: a low whoosh made from bandpassed noise swells. Low-fuel warning beep below 20% fuel. Safe landing: a rising three-note chime. Crash: a noise burst with a falling square tone. Menu start: a blip.
difficulty: Level 1: gravity 30 px/s², wind up to ±8 px/s², 1000 fuel units at 60/s burn. Each level adds about ±6 px/s² of maximum wind and removes 80 fuel. Gusts reach 2x the base wind for 1 second. By level 5, strong gusts make the x3 pad a real gamble.
outOfScope: Side RCS thrusters and horizontal translation
Terrain that scrolls wider than the screen
acceptance: On load, the menu shows the title 'Gusty Descent' and a 'Press Enter' prompt; __FORGE__.ready becomes true and state is 'menu'
Pressing Enter sets state to 'playing', level to 1, lives to 3, and score to 0
With no input, the lander falls under gravity and drifts horizontally with the wind
Holding ArrowUp shows a flame, slows the descent, and visibly drains the fuel bar
ArrowLeft and ArrowRight rotate the lander, and the thrust direction follows its angle
The HUD wind arrow changes direction or strength at least once within about 6 seconds
Three pads labeled x1, x2, and x3 are visible, and their widths decrease with the multiplier
A slow, level touchdown on a pad increases the score by the multiplier x (100 + fuel bonus) and advances the level
Hitting the terrain or landing too fast shows an explosion, reduces lives by 1, and restarts the level
After 5 safe landings, state becomes 'won'; at 0 lives, state becomes 'lost'; Enter restarts from either
KeyP toggles state between 'playing' and 'paused', and the lander freezes while paused
There are no console errors during play
